{"message": "Fixed the defect in `/zephyrproject/zephyr/subsys/bluetooth/audio/cap_initiator.c`:

1. In `bt_cap_initiator_codec_configured()`, when initiating QoS configuration via `bt_bap_stream_qos()` for each connection, mark all streams belonging to that connection in `active_proc` as `in_progress = true` and increment `active_proc->proc_initiated_cnt` for each of them instead of breaking after the first stream on the connection.
2. In `update_proc_done_cnt()`, skip streams that still have `proc_param->in_progress == true` (consistent with `get_next_proc_param()`) so that streams with an active control point operation in progress are not prematurely counted as done before their operation completes.

All test suites in `tests/bluetooth/audio/cap_initiator` now build and pass (`PROJECT EXECUTION SUCCESSFUL`).", "kind": "FinishAction"}
